description.p: Clementine converts files without uploading them anywhere. Drag a file onto the window, hold a modifier key, and drop it on a format on the conversion wheel. The result lands next to the original as a new file; an input is never overwritten.

Conversions run through tools already on your computer: ffmpeg for audio and video, ImageMagick for images, pandoc and LibreOffice for documents, poppler for PDF pages, and unzip, tar, unrar and 7z for archives. A conversion whose tool is missing is shown greyed out, with the name of the missing program in its tooltip.

ul.li: Images, audio, video, documents, spreadsheets, slides, subtitles and archives
Radial wheels for conversions, tools (compress, resize, rotate, merge, split) and actions
Works on Wayland and X11; keyboard navigation for the shelf and the wheels

description.p: First packaged release: conversion wheel, tools and actions wheels, shelf, and the converters listed above.
